acceptance: Census on develop: every code path that parses or generates SQL with the bundled SQLGlot during a run is listed with file:line and whether it records the runtime (command recorded, e.g. git grep for the vendored namespace imports in run paths).

Each listed path that changes executed SQL causes `execution.translation.runtime` to be recorded; a test per path runs a small benchmark (e.g. read_primitives on DuckDB or SQLite) and asserts the runtime block is present and matches benchbox/_vendor/sqlglot.json.
Paths that use SQLGlot without changing executed SQL are listed with the reason they record nothing.
No schema bump unless the owner approves (the block already exists).
context:
DECISION GATE: if recording needs a schema change or a new field, ask the owner. Related: bundle-translator-runtime-identity (done, #3712).

Census run 2026-11-09 against origin/develop 4c39e824a5 (read paths verified by hand). Root cause: every translating helper already records an outcome when a translation context is active; the gap is propagation. benchbox/core/throughput/executor.py DaemonStreamExecutor starts plain threading.Thread workers and calls fn() without a copied context, so in throughput stream workers the outcomes ContextVar is None (nothing recorded) and the strict ContextVar is its default False (a run requested as strict silently translates non-strict there). core/throughput/runner.py:172 is the only user, so every benchmark's throughput streams are affected whenever query text is generated inline in a worker (TPC-DS _get_stream_query_text; TPC-H inline fallback). No schema change or new field is needed: the existing execution.translation.runtime block is populated once the context reaches the workers. Decision gate not triggered. Not gaps: TPC-DS qualification already stamps version+fork_sha[:12].sha256[:12] in its own artifact (not a result bundle); data-only/setup-only result builders contain no SQL translation; read_primitives variants are returned verbatim (sqlglot not involved); split_sql_statements and parse-only helpers do not change executed SQL.
description: #3712 records `execution.translation.runtime` (distribution, version, fork_sha, upstream_sha, wheel_sha256) only when a run logs a SQL translation. Some paths rewrite SQL through the bundled SQLGlot without logging one, so their bundles record no runtime even though their SQL depends on the wheel: read_primitives variants and TPC-DS query qualification were named during the translator-provenance work (2026-10-28 to 2026-10-30). Their results cannot be tied to a wheel version, which is the gap the provenance work closed for logged translations.
